post_donation.title: How to Post a Surplus Food Donation
post_donation.prerequisites: Must be logged in with a verified Food Provider account.
steps: Sign in to your Food Provider account at /login.
Click 'Post Donation' in the left sidebar menu (or navigate directly to [Post Donation](/donations/new)).
Enter the food title, category (e.g. Cooked Meals, Bakery, Produce), quantity/servings, and estimated weight in kilograms.
Set the consumption expiry countdown and preferred pickup window.
Under Section 2 (Pickup Location), click 'Open Location Picker' to pin your exact pickup address on the interactive dark Leaflet map, then click 'SELECT LOCATION!'.
Click 'Submit Surplus Listing'. Your food batch is now live for nearby NGOs to claim.
post_donation.postAction: Nearby verified NGOs receive instant alerts. You can view competing claims on the listing's details page.

claim_food.title: How to Claim Surplus Food for a Shelter
claim_food.prerequisites: Must be logged in with an approved NGO/Shelter account.
steps: Sign in to your NGO account at /login.
Click 'Browse Donations' in the sidebar or go to [Browse Donations](/browse).
Use the category filter or proximity distance slider to discover surplus listings in your locality.
Click 'Claim Food' on any active card to open the claim modal.
Select your preferred fulfillment mode: 'Volunteer Courier Dispatch' or 'Direct Self-Pickup'.
Confirm your claim. The food provider will review competing claims using the smart priority algorithm.
claim_food.postAction: Track progress in [My Claims](/claims). Once accepted, a courier will be dispatched or your single-step pickup QR code will activate.

volunteer_delivery.title: How to Accept and Complete a Volunteer Rescue Mission
volunteer_delivery.prerequisites: Must be logged in as a Volunteer Courier.
steps: Sign in to your Volunteer account at /login.
Click 'My Deliveries' in the sidebar or go to [Deliveries](/deliveries).
Review available rescue tasks showing distance, donor pickup address, and receiving shelter destination.
Click 'Accept Mission' to claim the delivery run.
Travel to the food provider and scan their Pickup QR code (RESCUE-PK-XXXX) using the [QR Scanner](/qr-scan).
Complete the 4-Point Food Quality Inspection Checklist (Freshness, Packaging, Temperature, Portion Match) to transition status to 'in_transit'.
Transport the food to the receiving shelter and have the shelter representative scan your Dropoff QR code (RESCUE-DL-XXXX) to confirm completion.
volunteer_delivery.postAction: Your successful delivery is verified, ESG metrics are credited, and review eligibility unlocks.

download_receipt.title: Where and How to View / Download Donation Receipts
download_receipt.prerequisites: Must be logged in as the owning Food Provider or receiving NGO.
steps: Sign in to your account at /login.
Food Providers: Click 'My Donations' in the sidebar ([My Donations](/donations)). NGOs: Click 'My Claims' ([My Claims](/claims)).
Click on any completed donation with status 'delivered'.
The Donation Detail page displays the verified meal count, rescued kilograms, CO2 emissions avoided, handover timestamps, and courier confirmation.
An official automated completion receipt is also sent directly to your registered email address upon final QR dropoff verification.
download_receipt.postAction: You can print or save the email receipt or platform scorecard for your non-profit/tax records.

reset_password.title: How to Reset Your Account Password
reset_password.prerequisites: Available to Food Providers, NGOs, and Volunteers with a registered email.
steps: Go to the login screen and click 'Forgot Password?' or visit [Password Recovery](/forgot-password).
Enter your registered account email and click 'Send Verification Code'.
Check your email inbox for a 6-digit OTP code (valid for 10 minutes).
Enter the 6-digit code and choose a new secure password.
Click 'Reset Password'. You can now sign in with your new credentials.
reset_password.note: Super Administrator credentials cannot be reset via public OTP recovery for security.

delete_account.title: How to Delete Your Account (Danger Zone)
delete_account.prerequisites: All active donations, in-flight deliveries, or pending claims must be completed or cancelled first.
steps: Sign in to your account and click 'Profile' in the bottom sidebar or user menu ([Profile](/profile)).
Scroll down to the 'Danger Zone' section at the bottom of the page.
Click 'Delete Account'.
Enter your current password to confirm (or type 'DELETE' if signed in with Google OAuth).
Click 'Permanently Delete My Account'. Your profile, push tokens, and notification records will be safely cleaned up.
delete_account.note: Super Administrator accounts cannot be deleted to prevent platform lockout.

contact_support.title: How to Contact FoodRescue Support
contact_support.prerequisites: None (available to guests and all users).
steps: Visit the official contact directory at [Contact Support](/contact).
Our sole official communication channel is our dedicated project email: 2026.food.rescue@gmail.com.
Click 'Copy Email' or 'Send Email' to reach our 24/7 coordination desk directly from your mail client.
Our team typically responds within 2 to 4 hours.

algorithm.name: Smart Shelter Claim Requests & Selection Priority Algorithm

weights.hungerNeed: 35% (days since last donation, beneficiary scale, active claim dampener)
weights.communityReviews: 25% (Bayesian smoothed rating R_Bayes = (C*m + sum(r))/(C + n), C=3, m=4.2)
weights.absorptionCapacity: 20% (donation servings vs NGO daily intake capacity)
weights.reliability: 5% (verified NGO badge, delivery completion percentage >=95%, clean record)

badges.name: Best Match
badges.criteria: Highest composite priority score across all competing claims

badges.name: Highest Need
badges.criteria: Acute hunger deficit with hunger score >= 85

badges.name: Proximity Star
badges.criteria: Within 3 km with optimal absorption capacity
